text:
monica: Heads-up — I want to refresh the tiny hello quickstart (the minimal hello app we ship in starterkits). a couple issues flagged by new devs: env var handling is confusing, dockerfile example outdated, and CI snippet fails on token lookup.
sam: SG. can you list the exact pain points? I can pick the docker bits.
jordan: I saw a report that `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is referenced in the sample but the quickstart instructs `REDWOOD_KEY`. mismatch.
monica: exactly. also the curl example still uses the old v1 path and the Node snippet shows SDK7 import style. new onboarding should use sdk8 patterns and the oauth flow notes. short fixes: env var names, curl -> /v2/generate, node snippet -> esm import, and add a tiny docker-compose example for local dev.
alice: i'll own the env var rename + tests. will add a short migration note for existing users.
sam: i'll update Dockerfile & docker-compose. should we switch to ARG-based build-time token guidance instead of embedding env? (i think mention secrets manager ideally)
jordan: yes mention KMS + don't bake tokens. add a sample for local .env and for GH Actions secrets. GH snippet should be a tiny step to set REDWOOD_KEY as secret and use it in workflow.
monica: good. also want the quickstart to pass CI linting. current CI job uses node 16, but our sdk8 requires >=18. can someone update the workflow? small change: node-version: 20.
alice: will add matrix to test 18 & 20 briefly. i'll open a PR and tag you all. estimated 2–3 small commits.
monica: can we also include a one-line health check for the first deploy step so new users can verify success? e.g. curl /health -> 200
jordan: deploy-bot just reported staging deploys flaky if caching layer present. maybe add note to clear local cache when following example.
sam: also adding a `--watch` dev flag in the docker-compose so they can iterate locally.
monica: nice. doc-bot: can you add a checklist entry in the docs-maintenance board for backporting to all starterkits after changes land?
doc-bot: created card DOCS-4126 "tiny hello quickstart refresh" and linked PRs when available. :white_check_mark:
alice: opened PR 4528 with env fix + README adjustments. assigning sam & jordan for review.
jordan: reviewing now. small nit: change `process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || ''` to assert and show helpful error message.
sam: PR 4530 opened for Docker + workflow updates. includes node 20, docker-compose watch, and a short CI health check step.
monica: sweet. once both merge, i'll prep a tiny migration note in the changelog and ping #onboarding to surface the update to new hires.
alice: post-merge checklist: bump starterkit templates, regenerate quickstart zip on the site, and add a redirect from old curl example to new page (or fix link inline).
monica: timeline? can we ship these by end of week? folks: comment if blocked.
ajordan: will finish review within a few hours.
sam: will fix minor comments in the morning and merge.
monica: thanks — i'll follow up with a quick smoke-run and then close the doc-bot card. :rocket:

### Snippet we added in PR (for the quickstart README):
```
# minimal curl check after deploy
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://your-app.example.com/health
# expect 200
```

```js
// Node (ESM) sample for sdk8
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini-1', input: 'hello' });
console.log(res.output[0].text);
```

monica: tagging participants again: @sam @jordan @alice — ping if anything unexpected pops up.
